title: Externally validated deep learning model to identify prodromal Parkinson's disease from electrocardiogram
summary: A 1D-CNN trained on raw ECG waveforms was externally evaluated on chart-validated LUC cases, detecting a prodromal Parkinson's signal up to five years before diagnosis (external AUC 0.67, 95% CI 0.54–0.79); only 29 external PD cases and modest sensitivity limit the claim.
